## Running only the shell completion tests

All completion tests live in `tests/test_completion.py`:

```bash
uv run pytest tests/test_completion.py
uv run pytest tests/test_completion.py -v
uv run pytest tests/test_completion.py::test_name    # a single test
uv run pytest -k completion                          # match by name across tests/
```

To run under tox, pass extra arguments after `--`: `tox run -e py3.13 -- tests/test_completion.py`.

The pytest settings are in `pyproject.toml` under `[tool.pytest.ini_options]`:
- `testpaths` is `tests`.
- `filterwarnings = ["error"]` makes any warning fail a test.
- `addopts` skips tests marked `stress`.

## Linting and formatting

`.pre-commit-config.yaml` defines the hooks:
- `ruff-check`
- `ruff-format`
- `uv-lock`
- `codespell`, run with `--ignore-words-list=inout,te`
- a few basic `pre-commit-hooks` checks: merge conflicts, debug statements, trailing whitespace and end-of-file fixing.

Run them with `uv run pre-commit run --all-files` or `tox r -e style`. The `style` tox env is defined in `pyproject.toml` under `[tool.tox.env.style]`, and it runs the same pre-commit command.

The ruff rules are in `pyproject.toml` under `[tool.ruff]` and `[tool.ruff.lint]`:
- The selected rule sets are B, E, F, I, UP, W and ICN.
- Imports use force-single-line isort ordering.
- `typing` is aliased to `t`.
- `examples/` is excluded.

## Type checking

Run `tox r -e typing`. This is `[tool.tox.env.typing]` in `pyproject.toml`, and it runs two commands:
- `mypy`, configured in `[tool.mypy]`. It is strict, targets Python 3.10, and checks `src` and `tests/typing`.
- `pyright --ignoreexternal --verifytypes click`, configured in `[tool.pyright]`. It uses basic mode and checks the same paths.

You can also run them directly with `uv run mypy` and `uv run pyright`.

## CI

The CI workflows are in `.github/workflows/`. `tests.yaml` runs the tox matrix and `pre-commit.yaml` runs the style hooks.
